page.overview:
What is Nightmare Chica?

Nightmare Chica, also referred to as The Chick or The Chicken in the story, appears in Dittophobia, the third and final story of Tales from the Pizzaplex #8: B7-2 as one of the secondary antagonists torturing Rory. It was built by William Afton.

While torturing Rory, Nightmare Chica is a large, tattered yellow chicken-like animatronic with a massive mouth full of sharp teeth. Its lower jaw is separated from the top, allowing Rory to see his rooms wallpaper behind the chicken. It has massive hands with long, razor-like fingers, which held a bright pink cupcake. After the nightmare, Chica is revealed to be an an oversized mechanical puppet, with tattered fur hung on a metallic skeleton.

In Dittophobia, Chica is one of the few nightmarish creatures that torture Rory every night as he breathes in hallucinogenic gas. It enters Rory's bedroom through the door on the right side of his room, along with its nightmarish cupcake companion, slowly advancing its way to his bed. After the gas stops getting dispensed, Rory finds Chica at the end of the right hall, revealing it to be a mechanically-controlled animatronic puppet, with tears on its fur revealing more of its flimsy, metallic skeleton that helps it move.

While Nightmare Chica appears to be a moving animatronic, in reality, the nightmares true forms are mounted suit parts on rolling mechanical stands to emulate animatronics hunting someone, being turned into monsters by illusions as the result of the hallucinogenic gas.
